description: Find lawyers in Germany in the official register of the Bundesrechtsanwaltskammer. Give `city` (a German city or place; English names such as Munich or Cologne work; a 5-digit postcode is searched 10 km around, a smaller place 25 km), `name` (a lawyer or a firm), or both. Narrow with `area`, one of the 24 Fachanwalt areas in German or English ('Arbeitsrecht' or 'employment law', 'Strafrecht' or 'criminal law'), and `language` ('Türkisch' or 'Turkish'). Lawyers holding the Fachanwalt title for the area come first, then distance (postcode and place searches), then the combined rating. No paid placement; the order is no quality judgement. Next page: pass `next_offset` as `offset`. Each result has an `id` for get_lawyer and a `profile_url` to show the user. In-house lawyers (Syndikusrechtsanwälte) and lawyers who left the bar are not listed. Example: {"city": "Köln", "area": "Strafrecht", "language": "Arabic"}

area.description: Area of law, German or English. Values: Verwaltungsrecht (Administrative law); Steuerrecht (Tax law); Arbeitsrecht (Employment law); Sozialrecht (Social security law); Familienrecht (Family law); Strafrecht (Criminal law); Insolvenz- und Sanierungsrecht (Insolvency and restructuring law); Versicherungsrecht (Insurance law); Medizinrecht (Medical law); Miet- und Wohnungseigentumsrecht (Tenancy and condominium law); Verkehrsrecht (Traffic law); Bau- und Architektenrecht (Construction and architects' law); Erbrecht (Inheritance law); Transport- und Speditionsrecht (Transport and freight law); Gewerblicher Rechtsschutz (Intellectual property (trade marks, patents, designs)); Handels- und Gesellschaftsrecht (Commercial and company law); Urheber- und Medienrecht (Copyright and media law); Informationstechnologierecht (IT law); Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht (Banking and capital markets law); Agrarrecht (Agricultural law); Internationales Wirtschaftsrecht (International business law); Vergaberecht (Public procurement law); Migrationsrecht (Immigration law); Sportrecht (Sports law).

city.description: German city or place (Berlin, München or Munich, Köln or Cologne) or a 5-digit postcode.

language.description: A language the lawyer speaks besides German, German or English name. Most profiles do not list German itself.

name.description: A lawyer ('Daniel Schwartz', 'Schwartz') or a firm ('Gleiss Lutz'); umlaut spellings and one typo per word are tolerated.
